The history of this club is interesting, but its current policy is total nonsense. This club is strictly meant only for life members and their descendants. While I personally have no involvement with this, they should at least mention this crucial fact on their website.

However, the watchman informed me that membership is strictly hereditary, intended only for blood relatives. He also stated that no new memberships have been granted since 1995.
​This situation is truly disgusting because they fail to mention this restriction online. I assume that countless people must have visited over the years, only to leave disappointed. This current owner/s' mentality is extremely poor—it's a form of harassment for non-members, perhaps seeking publicity or some perverse pleasure.

featured_reviews.review_text:
I am writing to bring to your attention a very unfortunate incident that took place during our recent visit to Hindu Gymkhana. My family and I visit the club quite often and have always appreciated the environment and hospitality. However, this time we had an unpleasant experience which deeply hurt our religious sentiments.

We are pure Jains and had clearly placed an order for vegetarian dishes only. My father ordered a tomato omelette sandwich and specifically mentioned it as such to the waiter. However, the waiter repeatedly said “double omelette sandwich,” which my father did not realize referred to an egg-based dish. He assumed it was the same tomato omelette variant. Unfortunately, an egg omelette sandwich was served instead, and my father unknowingly consumed it.

Later, when the bill was presented, we noticed the item listed as egg omelette sandwich. We immediately clarified that there must be a mistake, as we had not ordered or ever consumed eggs. The waiter admitted that he had misunderstood the order but took no responsibility for the error. When we spoke to the caterer about it, the response was dismissive and insensitive.

To make matters worse, the waiter made an inappropriate comment, joking that “the chicken was Jain,” which was extremely disrespectful and offensive to our faith.

We believe this incident deserves serious attention. Serving non-vegetarian food to a Jain family after a clear vegetarian order, followed by mockery from the staff, is unacceptable. We request you to kindly look into this matter, take appropriate action, and ensure that such incidents do not happen again.

We have always valued Hindu Gymkhana and hope that the management will uphold the respect and trust of its members and guests.

Thank you for your understanding and prompt attention to this matter.

Garware Club House has a massive reputation, but their actions are incredibly small. If you are planning the most important day of your life here, my personal advice is to look elsewhere unless you want to spend your entire wedding drowning in stress.
Here is a breakdown of the reality behind the "big name":
• The Cancellation Trap (The Biggest Drawback): Please read their terms and conditions carefully. They reserve the right to cancel your hall booking at any time—even just 4 days before the wedding! While our wedding was thankfully saved, several weddings near our date were abruptly canceled simply because of a match or event at Wankhede Stadium. You will constantly be on edge.
• Unreliable & Poor Accommodations: You would expect the bride and groom to have a guaranteed space to get ready, but management can cancel your room booking for the most ridiculous reasons. Even if you do get a room, they are not in good condition. The ACs do not work properly, and the staff brushes off complaints with "renovation" excuses. No one listens to your issues, and no one actually cares about your event.
• Decorator Monopoly & Broken Promises: There is a strict monopoly of just two decorators, and their prices are exorbitantly high. Worse, they do not deliver on their commitments. Our grand entry was not executed as promised, guest chairs were missing, and the decorator didn’t even bother setting up a table for our family dinner.
• Hidden Costs & Extortionate Demands: You have to pay explicitly for valet parking. Then, after your event is over, the staff will hound you for extra money, acting as if they provided excellent service. Expect them to brazenly demand anywhere from ₹10,000 to ₹25,000.
• The Only Saving Grace: Swad Catering. The catering team was genuinely good, and the food tasted awesome.
Final Verdict: Save yourself the mental agony. Do not book this hall if you want peace of mind regarding whether your venue will actually be there on your wedding day. If you do consider it, read every single line of the terms and conditions before signing anything!

featured_reviews.review_text:
Dear Team  - YMCA Procter Branch Mumbai,

Today was the final day of my two-month training, and I could not let it pass without thanking the entire team.
I would like to extend my heartfelt gratitude to the entire team of YMCA Procter Branch Swimming Training Branch for providing such an excellent training experience over the last two months.

A very special thanks to Amul Raj Sir, Sebastian Paul Sir ,Peter Sir, Rashid Sir, Sadique Sir, Ashim Sir, Mr. Ali, Mr. Huzefa, and also to the Office Staff, caretakers, reception(Mr. Patil & Mr. Sudhir ) & housekeeping staff.

The entire team is truly excellent in both their work and their attitude, consistently creating a positive and motivating environment for all learners.

The program has been extremely well-structured, and I truly appreciate the dedication, support, and professionalism shown by all the coaches and staff.

Each one of them has contributed immensely—not just in teaching swimming techniques but also in creating an environment where beginners like me felt comfortable, confident, and motivated.

The trainers’ patience, personal attention, and continuous encouragement helped me overcome aquaphobia and learn to swim with confidence.

As a kidney transplant recipient who is grateful to have completed a decade post-surgery today (16th August 2025), I never imagined in my dreams that I could take up swimming. Yet, this journey has shown me that with the right guidance, patience, and encouragement, even the most distant goals can become achievable.

However, the coaches handled my case with utmost care, calmly guiding me through my skill gaps, correcting me on every dive, and advising me with patience.

While I have gained significant knowledge and comfort in swimming to the best of my physical ability, I am now motivated to further enhance my skills and continue this journey with YMCA Procter branch.

I must also mention that the pool facilities are maintained exceptionally well—clean, hygienic, and welcoming round the clock—which adds to the overall positive experience.

I would be delighted to continue my swimming journey with the YMCA Procter branch and further enhance my skills, progressing at a pace that aligns with my personal fitness and well-being.

Thank you once again to the entire YMCA Procter family for your dedication and warmth. I look forward to being part of your sessions again soon.

Warm regards,
Aamir
